This concentric ring target pattern is pathognomonic for **Early Blight** (*Alternaria solani*). The bullseye pattern with concentric rings, combined with the surrounding yellow halo, are the defining diagnostic features of Early Blight. Septoria Leaf Blotch would show smaller, more uniform spots with lighter centers. Late Blight would show water-soaked lesions without concentric rings.
